summary.text: Kenya Wade is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 44 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which Ballotpedia lists her as the only candidate.
She won the May 19 Democratic primary over incumbent Beverly Chester-Burton and Jesten Slaw.

paragraphs.text: Wade received 2,465 votes to Chester-Burton's 2,460 in the 2026 Democratic primary, with Slaw receiving 711.
